settings.starCharts.fleetLimit.name: Star Charts: enemy fleets per system
settings.starCharts.fleetLimit.tooltip: The most enemy fleets a Star Chart system spawns, not counting the boss or fleets added by the Crowded modifier. Lowering it merges the extra fleets into the rest, so each enemy fleet is larger and stronger and a run takes fewer, bigger fights. Raising it spreads the same enemies over more, smaller fleets. Default 7.
chart.ui.settings.openAnywhere.name: Star Charts: open wormholes anywhere
chart.ui.settings.openAnywhere.tooltip: When on, the Open Wormhole button in the Star Charts crafting window works anywhere outside a Star Chart system. When off, it only works while docked at a market with a working Wormhole Gateway. Off by default.

settings.starCharts.enabled.name: Star Charts
settings.starCharts.enabled.tooltip: When off, Star Charts and Ciphers stop dropping, and the Wormhole Gateway can't be built or used. A run that is already open plays out as normal. Charts you hold stay in storage, and switching this back on lets you use them again.

settings.starCharts.entries.tooltip: How many times your fleet can pass through a Star Chart's wormhole. When the last entry is used the wormhole collapses behind you, and leaving the system then ends the run. Read when a wormhole opens, so changing it doesn't affect a run that is already open.
chart.currency.reforge.description: Rerolls every modifier on a Star Chart at its tier.
chart.currency.annul.description: Removes every modifier from a Star Chart.
chart.currency.cartographer.description: Raises a Star Chart's tier by one, up to tier 15.
chart.currency.augmentation.description: Adds a modifier to a Star Chart, up to three prefixes and three suffixes. A common chart that gains its third modifier becomes rare.
chart.currency.recalibration.description: Rerolls the value of every modifier on a Star Chart within its tier's range.
chart.currency.attunement.description: Rerolls a Star Chart's implicit, so a different faction inhabits its system.
chart.currency.transposition.description: Turns a unique Star Chart into a different unique chart of its tier.
chart.currency.corruption.description: Corrupts a Star Chart, modifying it unpredictably.

chart.breach.core.confirm: Closing the breach removes every breach cache still inside it. Close it now?
